nav.label: Operations administration main menu
login.title: Sign in to operations administration
login.intro: Enter your operator e-mail. We will send a one-time code to it. Then we will ask for the code from your second-factor app.
login.email.label: E-mail
login.email.hint: We will send a six-digit code to this address. Operator accounts are created by the owner; you cannot register yourself.
login.error.invalidEmail: Enter a valid e-mail, for example name@example.com.
login.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
code.title: Enter the code from the e-mail
code.intro: If this e-mail belongs to an operator, we have sent a six-digit code to it. The code is valid for 10 minutes and can be used only once.
code.label: Six-digit code
code.hint: You can paste the code from your clipboard. If you do not see the e-mail, check your spam folder.
code.error.format: The code has six digits. Please check it.
code.error.wrong: The code is wrong or has expired. Check it or request a new one.
code.error.expired: The sign-in has expired. Please request a new code.
mfa.title: Second factor
mfa.intro: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app. If you do not have the app at hand, enter one of your backup codes.
mfa.label: Code from the app or a backup code
mfa.hint: Six digits from the app, or a ten-character backup code. You can paste it from your clipboard.
mfa.error.format: Enter six digits from the app, or a ten-character backup code.
mfa.error.invalid: The code is wrong or has already been used. An app code can be used only once, wait for the next one.
mfa.error.locked: Entering codes is temporarily paused. Try again in {pause}.
mfa.error.session: The sign-in has expired. Please start again with your e-mail.
enroll.title: Set up the second factor
enroll.intro: Before you can enter the administration, you must register an authenticator app (for example Aegis, Google Authenticator or a password manager with TOTP support).
enroll.step1: 1. Add this key to the app: scan the QR code, or type or paste the key.
enroll.qr.label: QR code for the authenticator app. The same key is also given as text below it.
enroll.secret.label: Key for manual entry
enroll.step2: 2. Enter the six-digit code the app shows.
enroll.code.label: Six-digit code from the app
enroll.code.hint: You can paste the code from your clipboard.
enroll.error.format: The code has six digits. Please check it.
enroll.error.invalid: The code does not match. Check the time on your phone and try the next code from the app.
enroll.codes.title: Save your backup codes
enroll.codes.intro: The second factor is set up. Save these codes in a safe place outside your phone, for example in a password manager. Each can be used once when you do not have the app. They will not be shown again.
enroll.codes.continue: I have saved them, continue to the administration

action.status.title: Change status
action.status.label: New status
action.status.supportHint: Support may only block a website. Other status changes are made by the owner.
action.reason.label: Reason
action.reason.hint: It is recorded in the order history and in the audit log.
action.slug.title: Change website address
action.slug.label: New address
action.slug.hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, for example klara-a-matej-2027. An old published address is never given to anyone else.

action.link.label: Admin
action.link.hint: We will send the admin a one-time code and a link. They sign in only after confirming on the page.

action.note.title: New note
action.note.label: Note
action.note.hint: No guest personal data. At most 2000 characters.
action.guests.title: Guest data
action.guests.intro: By default there is no access. Guest data is shown only when the couple has given time-limited consent. Every access attempt, including refused ones, is recorded in the audit log with the reason.
action.guests.consent.active: The couple’s consent is valid until {until}.
action.guests.consent.none: The couple has not given consent now (or it has expired).
guests.denied: Access was refused: the couple has not given consent. The attempt is recorded in the audit log.
guests.empty: Consent is valid, but the wedding has no guests.
guests.caption: Guest data, visible only while consent lasts
guests.col.name: Name

success.slug: The website address has been changed.
success.link: The sign-in link has been sent to the admin.
success.operatorCreate: The operator has been created. They will set up the second factor at first sign-in.
success.operatorDisable: The operator has been disabled and their sessions ended.

error.notExtension: A deadline can only be extended: the new date must be later than the current one.
error.datePast: The date must not be in the past.
error.notRestorable: A website can be restored only before the protection period after deletion ends.
error.cannotPublish: The website cannot be published because it has no published version or address.
error.useRestore: A deleted website is brought back by restoring, not by changing the status.
error.invalidNote: The note must have 1 to 2000 characters.

error.selfNotAllowed: You cannot do this to yourself.

retention.intro: Orders whose service ends or whose data is due for deletion within {days} days. The list only shows deadlines, it deletes nothing.
retention.caption: Upcoming deadlines

jobs.intro: The last run of each lifecycle and retention job. If a job fails or has no recent success, check the server logs.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Records of interventions and sign-ins. They contain only identifiers, counts and statuses, no guest personal data. Records cannot be changed or deleted.
audit.filter.error.wedding: The order identifier is a UUID.
audit.table.caption: Audit records
operators.title: Operators
operators.intro: Only the owner manages operators. A new operator sets up the second factor at first sign-in. A lost second factor is reset below; an owner’s factor is reset by another owner or by following the operations guide.
operators.table.caption: List of operators
operators.create.title: Add an operator
operators.disable.title: Disable or enable an operator
operators.reset.title: Reset the second factor
operators.reset.intro: This invalidates the operator’s key and backup codes and ends their sessions. The operator sets up a new factor at the next sign-in. Do this only after verifying their identity.
account.title: My account
account.regenerate.title: New set of backup codes
account.regenerate.intro: Old codes stop working. The new ones are shown only once.
account.codes.title: New backup codes
account.codes.intro: Save them in a safe place. They will not be shown again.
blog.title: Blog
blog.intro: Articles are stored as content/blog/*.json files in the repository. Edit them in local development (npm run dev), check the preview and send them in a commit. They go live with the next deployment.
blog.readOnly: Articles are read-only here. Edit them in local development and send the changes in a commit.

blog.create.title: New article
blog.edit.title: Edit article
blog.back: Back to the list of articles
blog.field.idHint: Lowercase letters without diacritics, digits and hyphens. It can’t be changed later.
blog.field.slugHint: The part of the address after /blog/. Lowercase letters without diacritics, digits and hyphens.
blog.field.title: Title
blog.field.titleHint: 10 to 70 characters. It is also the page title in search results.
blog.field.descriptionHint: 70 to 170 characters. Shown below the title and in search results.
blog.field.bodyHint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line. ## heading, ### subheading, - bullet, 1. numbered item, > tip, **bold**, [link text](/address).

error.blogExists: An article with this identifier already exists.
error.blogSlugTaken: Another article already uses this address. Choose a different one.
error.blogReadOnly: Articles can’t be saved here. Edit them in local development.
